test_item:
Encryption procedure should be:
(symmetric key differs between two encryption iterations)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Logdog is enabled on the DUT
3. Private keys are installed on the DUT
4. A USB drive containing __diagSpecialFile and __getSnapshot is inserted into the HU USB port
proc:
1. Decrypt the first encrypted pair on the host
$ ./logdecrypt_Ver2.sh HUssss_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_XXXX.enc HUssss_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_XXXX_enckey.enc
2. Decrypt the second encrypted pair on the host
$ ./logdecrypt_Ver2.sh HUssss_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_XXXX.enc HUssss_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_XXXX_enckey.enc
3. PENDING: X-m two log snapshots taken in separate iterations + comparison
er:
1. The logdecrypt_Ver2.sh tool creates the folder HUssss_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_XXXX on the host
2. The logdecrypt_Ver2.sh tool creates the folder HUssss_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_XXXX on the host
3. PENDING: X-m two log snapshots taken in separate iterations + comparison
